name: The Storm Risen
flavour: The Storm bucks. Eight seconds is a long time up there.
art_prompt: a wild brown bronco horse rearing and bucking with its hind legs high, an empty saddle flying off its back, a puff of dust

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: a wild bucking horse silhouette rearing inside a bold spiral tornado, in icy blue, white and grey.
